description: Shared conformance vectors of the Tungo SDKs. Hand-maintained; the structure is documented at the top of conformance_test.go in tungo-sdkgen, which verifies every case against a Go standard-library reference implementation.

cases.name: valid, header names in mixed case
valid, second of two signatures matches
valid, unknown signature versions are skipped
valid signature, data lacks required properties (tolerant decoding)
signature header without a v1 entry
secret that is only the prefix
timestamp exactly at the old edge of the tolerance
timestamp exactly at the future edge of the tolerance
custom tolerance accepts an older message
custom tolerance still rejects beyond it
zero tolerance is a configuration error, not 'disabled'
negative tolerance is a configuration error

verify.name: empty secret is rejected even when the HMAC with an empty key matches

to_tiyn.name: '-0.004' rounds to zero, not minus zero

bin_iin.name: no valid check digit exists (both passes give 10)

expect.message: Баланс платформы исчерпан — пополните счёт в кабинете.

no header: use the computed backoff

chat_stream.name: text deltas, then done with usage and cost
progress removes the text of its step; ping is skipped
done.answer replaces the accumulated text
mid-stream error event, then done
question to the user: awaiting_user with choice_id
unknown event type, unknown fields and missing required properties do not break the stream
